pages.text: $(thing)Simply Swords$(/thing) adds 42 unique named weapons. In $(thing)IridescentCraft$(/thing), all 42 are boss-drop-only.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) $(thing)Simply Swords$(/thing) weapons are the best weapons available. Every unique is assigned to a specific boss with a specific drop chance. They are trophies as much as they are tools.$(br2)$(bold)Weapon types:$(/bold) Greatswords, Longswords, Katanas, Spears, Staffs, Warglaives, Scythes, Sabres, and more.

$(bold)How to get them:$(/bold) Kill the matching boss. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon). There are no other sources.$(br2)$(bold)Enchanting compatibility:$(/bold) All $(thing)Simply Swords$(/thing) uniques are fully compatible with $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing) enchanting and affix reforging. A unique weapon with Legendary affixes and max enchants is the endgame weapon ceiling.
Craft the $(bold)Runic Grimoire$(/bold) for the full Simply Swords reference — all 42 unique weapons, runic socket effects, gem interactions, and weapon-specific mechanics.
